name: Rise, Obsidion!
summary: At the archaeologist’s gasp, you learn the truth: the rescue was a trap. They beg you to avenge them and Thorius by killing Lathoric the Black and Obsidion. Curator Thorius in Ironforge needs proof.

sections.title: A Dying Plea
sections.body: The archaeologist can barely speak. They gasp that it was all a trap, ask forgiveness, then plead for you to kill the traitor for them and for Thorius. Lathoric the Black and Obsidion must both fall. Curator Thorius in Ironforge needs proof: one head and one heart.

sections.title: A Voice Answers
sections.body:
Dorius calls you fools. He played on his brother’s weak feelings and sent rescuers so they would take the last Suntara stone from the Twilight's Hammer. At the Grimesilt Digsite, he found the Suntara stones. Then Ragnaros's power surged through him and gave him purpose.

By Ragnaros's will, Obsidion was built to destroy the Blackrock orcs of Blackrock Spire. Reborn as an acolyte of fire, Dorius took the name Lathoric the Black. In Ironforge, Thorius turns pale at the proof: his own brother set all this in motion and betrayed him and Ironforge. Thorius fears the Old Gods still hold strong sway here. If so honorable a man could be turned so easily to Ragnaros, no one is safe.

faq.answer: A dying archaeologist gives it, begging you to avenge them and Thorius.

faq.q: Who do you bring the proof to?
faq.answer: Bring the proof to Curator Thorius in Ironforge. He wants a head and a heart.

faq.q: Who are you sent to slay?
faq.answer: You are sent to slay Lathoric the Black and Obsidion.
